Name: AT - SH's Fluffy Bunnies - Angora Rabbit Replacers
Author: plurffle
Description:
Did you ever want your rabbits to be all fluffy in your coops? I did too, so here they are ready for your farm! ₍ ᐢ.ˬ.ᐢ₎ ♡

This mods comes with replacers of the adult rabbit sprites as well as the baby rabbits sprites, both rabbits coming with three colors (tan, tan with white, and white). The adult rabbits also comes with two different coat lengths: short-haired and long-haired.


[img]https://imgur.com/bBYKTj4.png[/img]
[b][size=3]Q: [/size]How to install this mod?[/b]
[size=3][b]A: [/b][/size]Unzip the zip file and place the "[AT] SH's Fluffy Bunnies - Rabbit Replacers" folder in your Mods folder.

[b][size=3]Q: [/size]Is this mod compatible with mobile/multiplayer?[/b]
[b]A: [/b]I do not have the mobile version of the game and I currently have no clue if the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url] mod works in mobile. This should definitely work in multiplayer though!

[b][size=3]Q: [/size]Is there going to be a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] version of this mod?[/b]
[size=3][b]A: [/b][/size]You can get that here! [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/42484]CP - SH's Fluffy Bunnies - Rabbit Replacers[/url]



I have a Ko-fi btw! If you like my works, then feel free to [url=https://ko-fi.com/smolhooman_plurffle]buy me a coffee[/url]﻿~! I'll greatly appreciate the support! <3 However, my mods will always stay free for the public!
